info.title: local-paas management API
info.description: Private operator API with camelCase fields. Controller, dashboard and protocol v2 agents must be upgraded together.

html.description: A complete UTF-8 HTML template, or null to restore the platform default.

githubAppId.description: GitHub App ID. Supply all three GitHub App fields for private access.

githubInstallationId.description: Repository installation ID for this app.

githubPrivateKey.description: PEM-encoded GitHub App private key. Stored only in OpenBao.

repository.description: GitHub `owner/repository` identity or its credential-free HTTPS URL.

webhookSecret.description: Shared GitHub webhook secret. It is written to OpenBao and never returned.

status.description: Derived from current observations and expiry, never an operator-set success flag.

services.description:
Services copied into each preview. Empty preserves the legacy behavior:
only the source connection's service is included with no secret grants.

githubPrivateKey.description: Replacement PEM-encoded GitHub App private key.
